LLCV for Linux frame interpolation

RIFE Vulkan Fast, ported from the Windows LLCV 2.4.0 RIFE Vulkan path. The
NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation (VFG) path of the Windows build is not ported.

Practical-RIFE 4.25 model, converted to ncnn by the Windows LLCV project
Copyright (c) 2021 hzwer. MIT license. See RIFE-MODEL-LICENSE.txt.
https://github.com/hzwer/Practical-RIFE
rife-fast/ holds the four files shipped in LowLatencyCaptureViewer_v2.4.0_x64.zip
(https://github.com/seria-aa/LowLatencyCaptureViewer/releases/tag/v2.4.0),
unchanged:
  fast-fold-cache.ncnn.param  7555b43762cd23cb38139f0719fe72aa1d599c862c86c2f255ce451999523b9c
  fast-fold-cache.ncnn.bin    95d45db607cb8e0896f10990e5b6667a88ca64429ea4b00349f41211f7775a93
  fast-encoder.ncnn.param     ee51d9303fb015bfb888b634436e75b9ec0e9bc3fcb48d5eb7b1c0f0b4b83c01
  fast-encoder.ncnn.bin       16af9ff58f802d0b1050ed2289ee537fc359cbf3d52e29b3938273fac6a36a23
They are installed to share/llcv/rife-fast.

ncnn 20261020
Copyright (C) 2017 Tencent. BSD 3-Clause license with third-party components.
See NCNN-LICENSE.txt.
https://github.com/Tencent/ncnn/releases/tag/20261020
tools/fetch-ncnn.sh downloads ncnn-20261020-full-source.zip (SHA-256
699d9acc67489eee0993a551ca1ebc247bbf0f4e33babe1dec810e6a9a52b988) and applies
ncnn-20261020-replay.patch, the Windows LLCV patch unchanged: VkCompute with
GPU timestamps and a reusable command buffer, resubmit_and_wait and
elapsed_gpu_ms. tools/build-ncnn-static.sh builds it with Vulkan and the
bundled glslang (NCNN_SIMPLEVK, the Vulkan loader is opened at run time) and
llcv links it statically.

glslang (bundled in the ncnn source)
Copyright (C) 2015-2018 Google, Inc., The Khronos Group Inc. and others.
Several licenses for its parts (BSD 3-Clause, BSD 2-Clause, MIT, Apache 2.0).
See GLSLANG-LICENSE.txt.

src/video/rife/ncnn/*.h and src/video/rife/RifeGraph.cpp, RifeHistoryPolicy.h
come from the Windows LLCV sources with include paths and namespaces changed.
src/video/rife/RifeBackend.cpp replaces the Direct3D 11 bridge with OpenGL
shared textures and semaphores (GL_EXT_memory_object_fd, GL_EXT_semaphore_fd)
and keeps the Windows pack, unpack and HUD protection shaders.
